images.prompt: Create a clean SIX-FRAME SPRITE SHEET on true TRANSPARENT background, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of equal cells, row-major order. One complete isolated character per cell with generous clear alpha gutters; NO text, labels, grid, terrain, shadows, effects, tools outside the character, or repeated props. All six depict the EXACT SAME supplied character with identical design, materials, pixel grain, outline, head dimensions, torso and limb thickness. Use crisp discrete pixel-art clusters readable when reduced, not smooth illustration. Elevated oblique RPG view as reference, facing toward viewer-left. Keep identical zoom, anatomy scale and head width across cells; lower poses become shorter by bending joints, NEVER by shrinking the head or squashing the whole sprite. Align lowest weight-bearing foot/knee to the same cell baseline; all extremities entirely inside cells. 1536x1024 sheet. The character is the supplied massive stone pack-carrying puppet/golem, retain the round pale stone mask with two black holes, leafy crown, dark green and yellow cloth, pumpkin charms, timber backpack with barrel and lantern, huge open stone hands. Keep fingers and arms held forward in the same reaching direction as the reference; the legs visibly alternate during walking. Frames 1-4 are FOUR DISTINCT chronological heavy walking poses: (1) left foot forward right foot back, (2) weight over left foot with right heel lifting, (3) right foot forward left foot back, (4) weight over right foot with left heel lifting. Clear foot separation, not identical idle poses. Frame5: stopped with one knee fully on ground, other foot planted, body upright but physically lower, hands at rest; the head remains full size. Frame6: from that same kneeling stance, bends neck and upper torso forward into a visible apologetic bow, head lowered, same full size and same ground footprint. Do not add a weapon or angry face.
